notes:
Three iterations on crop overlay styling for shaped panels:
1. Thinned border: lineWidth=2->1, stroke alpha 0.85->0.55, fill alpha 0.18->0.10
2. Zero fill alpha: drawShapeOverlay fill set to rgba(255,255,255,0) so image is fully visible
3. Root cause fix: replaced destination-out compositing with evenodd compound path fill. The destination-out approach was fundamentally different from how rectangular panels work (4 fillRect calls that never touch the crop interior). The evenodd approach draws the dark overlay once with a compound path (canvas rect + shape), filling everything EXCEPT the shape interior — matching the rectangular panel behavior exactly. No save/restore or compositing mode switching needed.

beginPathFromPoints gained a continuePath parameter for compound path support.
Updated 9 test assertions across CropOverlayShapeTest.html and CropPreviewTest.html.
